allow: Shell(echo "=== listening on 5000 ==="; ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':5000|LISTEN' | head -30; echo; echo "=== fprime/gds/python procs ==="; ps aux | grep -Ei 'fprime|gds|flask|fprime-gds|Gds' | grep -v grep | head -30; echo; echo "=== hostname / tailscale ==="; hostname; tailscale status 2>&1 | head -20; echo; echo "=== curl http to localhost:5000 ==="; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w 'http_code=%{http_code} scheme=%{scheme}\n' http://127.0.0.1:5000/ 2>&1; echo "=== curl https to localhost:5000 ==="; curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w 'http_code=%{http_code}\n' https://127.0.0.1:5000/ 2>&1)

Shell(cd /tmp echo "=== crawl referenced modules ===" for u in js/loader.js js/uploader.js js/datastore.js addons/enabled.js js/vue-support/tabetc.js third-party/js/vue.min.js third-party/js/luxon.min.js css/fprime.css css/fpstyle.css; do code=$(curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:5000/$u") echo "$code $u" done echo echo "=== addons/enabled.js ===" curl -sS -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:5000/addons/enabled.js echo echo "=== flask static dir in venv ===" find /home/vince/workspace/fprime-wsts/.venv -path '*fprime_gds*' -name 'enabled.js' 2>/dev/null | head)

Shell(S=/home/vince/workspace/fprime-wsts/.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/fprime_gds/flask/static cd "$S" echo "=== HTTP status + content-type for every static file ===" find . -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.svg' -o -name '*.ico' \) | sed 's|^\./||' | sort | while read -r f; do read code ct < <(curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}' "http://127.0.0.1:5000/$f") printf '%-6s %-28s %s\n' "$code" "$ct" "$f" done | grep -vE '^200 +(text/javascript|text/css|image/svg\+xml|image/vnd.microsoft.icon|image/x-icon)' | head -40 echo "=== done (lines above are the odd ones) ===")
